report.clinical_summary: The patient presents with chronic headaches, crashes of exhaustion, low-grade fevers, and general fatigue that have been worsening over time. They've tried rest, hydration, and over-the-counter pain relievers but found them insufficient. Bloodwork came back normal. Symptoms are significantly impacting their work (frequent breaks, calling in sick) and social life (avoiding gatherings). They experience guilt, anxiety, and worry about their health. They have theories about causes (work stress, diet, family history) but lack understanding of what's happening and are unsure what questions to ask. They're open to targeted testing and want advice on approaching their doctor.
